name: Muhammad Umair
headline: Full-Stack Developer (Laravel / PHP)
summary: Laravel developer who's shipped production systems for UAE healthcare, hospitality, trading, and interior-design clients — from zero to live in weeks, not quarters. Backend-strong (APIs, SOLID architecture, MySQL), frontend-capable across React/Inertia.js and HTML5/CSS3/Ajax, and currently closing the gap into Vue.js/Angular through applied, AI-assisted builds.

highlights: Architected modular, reusable RESTful APIs in Laravel using Action-based design patterns and SOLID principles, improving code maintainability and reducing duplication across the backend codebase.
Strengthened platform security by implementing robust authentication and authorization mechanisms, reducing unauthorized-access risk across all API endpoints.
Cut average API response time by re-architecting slow database queries and adding targeted indexing across core service endpoints.

Delivered five production client platforms for UAE-based clients spanning healthcare, hospitality, trading, and interior design: three as Laravel + Filament back ends with React/Inertia.js front ends (Doctors For You, Emkaan, Al-Sadi Group), and two as WordPress/Elementor sites (Oilly Hair Care Salon, Altura) — enabling non-technical staff to manage day-to-day operations independently.
Replaced manual, spreadsheet-based operations with custom Filament workflows for the Laravel-based client platforms, cutting routine admin tasks from hours to minutes per day.

Maintained and updated multiple live WordPress/Elementor sites using HTML5 and CSS3, delivering responsive layout changes on tight client turnaround windows while coordinating requirements directly with stakeholders.
Increased application performance by 40% on the Banibanna platform, measured by reduced page load times under production traffic, by optimizing backend logic and database queries.
Raised user satisfaction by 25% on the Ukaam platform, as measured by client feedback scores, by redesigning the interface using HTML5, CSS3, and Ajax-driven dynamic profile updates.
Achieved a 95% real-time message delivery rate by integrating Firebase Cloud Messaging for push notifications, enabling instant user-facing alerts.

Built a full-cycle matrimonial web platform in Laravel, integrating secure Gmail-based authentication and Ajax for live profile updates, collaborating directly with the product team over a two-year engagement to translate requirements into shipped features.
